title: Path Traversal via URL appendingPathComponent
platform_conditions: iOS/macOS SDK (Foundation URL/FileManager) with Swift runtime semantics; sandbox boundary rules are iOS/macOS specific
security_mechanism: URL.appendingPathComponent(percentEncoded:) percent-encodes '/' only when the API notices it, and the string-based variants historically kept '../' sequences intact, so a name like '../../Private/doc' appended to a sandbox container URL escapes the intended directory once FileManager resolves the path. Symbolic links inside a writable directory (downloads, documents imported from other apps, archive members) redirect writes outside the sandbox even when the resolved prefix was checked earlier — the check and the write race. Archive extraction trusting member names repeats the class; security-scoped bookmarks resolving to attacker-influenced paths can widen the sandbox boundary the app was granted.

source_sink_clues.source: File names from other apps (open-in, share extensions), archive entry names, server-supplied download names, and document provider inputs.
source_sink_clues.sink: baseDir.appendingPathComponent(userInput) / FileManager contentsOfDirectory and copyItem at the resolved path; symlink-following writes; archive entry extraction without member validation; predictable temp names in shared containers

tracking_guards: Check the incoming name is stripped to its lastPathComponent or re-validated against a strict pattern before appending; check the final URL's path, after resolving (URL(fileURLWithPath:).standardized / resolvingSymlinksInPath), still has the intended base as its prefix at write time; check archive extraction validates each entry name and the temporary names come from a random generator.
not_candidate_when: Names are generated server/app-side (UUIDs) and never taken from the client, the component is reduced to lastPathComponent plus a post-append prefix check on the resolved path, or the destination directory contains no attacker-writable symlinks and the app verified it at write time.
synthetic_safe_example: let clean = (userInput as NSString).lastPathComponent; let dest = baseDir.appendingPathComponent(clean)
public_references: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory — https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/22.html
CWE-59: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access — https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/59.html
